attempted_claim: Let M=(E,C) be a cographic oriented matroid of rank r>=1, e in E, and B,B' e-embracing bases of M. Is the e-embracing exchange distance d_e(B,B')<=r? Either prove the bound for all such M, or exhibit an explicit rank-and-ground-set witness family (minimal rank r_0, ground set E_0 containing e_0, e_0-embracing bases B_0,B_0') with d_{e_0}(B_0,B_0')>r_0.
decisive_failure: No proof and no witness family for the target claim were produced; the decision-phase subset-middle statement (375 cut pairs, 748 tight pairs) is empirical support, not a theorem; all computations cover graphs through n=9/m=16 (complete only through n=5/m=8) and cannot rule out large-or-exotic violations; the Lemma is an immediate corollary of Theorem 1.3 of Berzci-Knauer-Montejano-Nador 2026 and is not claimed as original.
